summary: Scope 11 race and restart proofs at candidate 8104ee4517, the head of lane/orchestration-race-restart. The lane branched from develop bfce3d9249, made four proof commits (dc5ce85c6f, e012a30346, 9f0edfc0a5, cf78af5710), merged develop d55ab04388 at f7854e779e, and ended with the review-fix commit 8104ee4517, which writes a background subagent run's settlement as a durable bake.subagent.settled Pi custom entry before its notice is posted, proves the reminder re-check against a schedule_delete between a look's decision and its dispatch write, and bounds every await. Its base is d55ab04388, the develop commit the candidate contains. The 0.4 Linux integration merged it at 7ef54778c7. Evidence is one Linux x86_64 host, this Fedora Linux 44 machine: a workspace nextest run at d0c1891829 (all six lanes merged, before the integration's docs), 3190 cases all passed with 8 skipped, whose saved log holds only its summary and no exit status, so no result cites it; and the full Linux preflight at the integration head 3421fd94ce, 39 gates passed with actionlint skipped, whose rust-test gate ran 3092 nextest cases, all passed with 8 skipped, plus the codemode harness's 98. The preflight log names the commit and umask 022; the orchestrating session reports BAKE_REQUIRE_KERNEL_FAULTS=1 and BAKE_REQUIRE_SANDBOX_BACKENDS=bwrap,landlock and a clean tree, which the log does not record. Between the candidate and 3421fd94ce only a comment in rust/crates/bake-cli/tests/print_mode/subagents.rs changed among the fixture sources below. The paired eval 2026-10-22-subagent-settlement, eight models, three trials, 48 successful samples, flags no regression; it cannot reach the stop window the settlement record changes, which the restart and barrier tests cover. The lane and fix workers' mutation controls left no logs. This is the first scope 11 record and supersedes nothing. Goals and the task router are deferred by D48; a host SIGKILL leaves child and job processes running; macOS, Windows, aarch64, and reviewer acceptance are missing.

results.behavior: subagents::tests::restart::a_killed_parent_reports_each_child_run_once_and_reruns_none passed in the rust-test gate, with subagent_crash_fixture, its child entry point: the test SIGKILLs a parent process while a background child's request runs, once the child's settlement is recorded and its notice posted, once its notice is synced, and while a foreground child runs. Both files load, the child's parentSession names the parent, and the resumed parent's next request is provider-valid and never reruns the child. A run whose settlement was recorded gets that finished notice once, word for word; a run in flight gets one interrupted notice; a synced notice is not admitted again; an open foreground call gets Pi's synthetic result. A second resume reports nothing, and a background child continues as a new run. bake-cli's print_mode subagents::a_killed_print_run_reports_its_running_subagent_once_after_continue passed: a real bake -p is SIGKILLed while a background child runs, and two --continue runs report it once. Counts describe nextest test cases.

subagents::tests::barrier passed, 3 tests: a_child_settling_around_a_parent_stop_is_admitted_once (a background child settles just before, during, or just after a parent abort and a parent shutdown, each run admitted once), notices_are_admitted_in_settlement_order_once_each (two children settling in the reverse of their start order), and a_parent_stops_its_children_jobs_and_reminders_bottom_up (after Esc stops only the parent's turn, shutdown ends the child's turn and session, the child's own job, a job's real process, checked with kill(pid, 0) returning ESRCH, and the reminder timer before it returns, asserting the order of six endings without sorting). Waits are on gates the scripted model holds, never on time.

agent_session::job_journal::tests::a_killed_host_reports_its_process_job_once_and_never_restarts_it passed, with process_job_crash_fixture and job_journal_crash_host: a host SIGKILL while a real sh job process runs after its durable start reports the job lost once and never starts it again; one after the job exited with its terminal fact synced reports the recorded outcome once; a second resume reports neither. The existing crash_after_started_durability_precedes_the_producer, crash_after_terminal_durability_precedes_publication, and crash_after_observation_durability_precedes_acknowledgement passed with their SIGKILL exit checks.

agent_session::schedules::tests::race passed, 5 tests plus reminder_crash_fixture: a_delete_between_decision_and_dispatch_writes_no_dispatch (the race a session's single timer can hit, which without the re-check leaves the log corrupt), clock_jumps_forward_and_back_deliver_each_occurrence_at_most_once, a_dst_gap_is_refused_and_an_overlap_fires_once (New York; a fixed-rate reminder keeps its UTC interval), an_overdue_reminder_is_delivered_once_across_resumes, and a_killed_session_delivers_a_reminder_at_most_once (SIGKILL before a dispatch, after it, after delivery, and after a fixed-rate dispatch). bake-cli's print_mode schedules::a_reminder_dispatched_before_a_kill_is_never_delivered_again passed through a real bake -p. Each counts durable dispatches and posted and delivered reminders: an occurrence reaches the model at most once.

bake-cli's print_mode subagents::no_goal_surface_is_reachable_from_any_composition passed: with every opt-in on and goal-shaped settings present, no parent, child, or default composition declares a goal tool, and RPC answers goal as an unknown command (D48). The task_document tool's goal document kind is D37's and is not checked.
The acceptance matrix's router-failure case for scope 11.
results.reason: D48 defers goals and the task router beyond 0.4.0, so no router can fail.

negativeControls.missing: No control kept a log. The lane worker reports ten one-line mutations on its uncommitted worktree before the review fix, each applied, run, and reverted (M1 to M10: the look's re-check disabled, an active reminder kept, the DST fold reversed, the notice projection disabled, a notice posted twice, a child's shutdown skipped, a killed job reported completed, two job-notice checks disabled, and the subagent-model listing replaced by a goal one), each failing the named tests. The fix worker reports nine more on its uncommitted worktree before 8104ee4517, driven by a scratch script: removing the current != due re-check (the log is reported corrupt: schedule dispatch targets inactive id); the hook after the dispatch write (before-dispatch count 1, not 0); posting without record_fact (restart and barrier expected [(1, "completed")], got []); lost runs ignoring records (interrupted text, not finished); run 2's notice posted twice (the exact list fails, which the old dedup would pass); finished.send_replace(true) before the drain (4 events, not 6); a detached child shutdown (order fails); the timer on a fresh WorkGate (no timer event); and a panic after kill_fixture (no leaked sleep or temporary directory). Neither saved output, an exit status, or a tree.

missingEvidence.what: Processes of a child or job after a host SIGKILL
missingEvidence.reason: A child's bash and job processes lead their own process groups with no parent-death signal, so a host SIGKILL leaves them running; the process-job test kills its orphaned sleep itself, and no orphan-process guarantee is claimed.

missingEvidence.what: The stop window in a model eval
missingEvidence.reason: The paired eval cannot stop a host between a settlement record and its notice; the Rust restart and barrier tests cover the only model-visible difference.

None saved a log; the runs above stand in for them.
The preflight skipped it: actionlint 1.7.12 or later is not on PATH.

rollback.observed: The crash fixture re-runs one of the test binary's own fixture tests as a child, kills it with SIGKILL at the point it reports, checks the exit signal, and reopens what it left in the test's own directory; the kill fixtures arm their guards first and keep temporary files inside that directory, and every wait has a timeout. Barrier tests wait on the scripted model's gates. The process-job test kills the orphaned sleep its killed host leaves. Reminder tests run on the test clock. No user home is touched. The preflight log opens with its commit and umask 022 and records no git status; the orchestrating session reports the tree clean.

review.missing: No reviewer has accepted scope 11. The orchestrating session's review agents reviewed the lane and a fix worker fixed their findings in 8104ee4517; that is not scope acceptance.
